Four V7 declared joint families and six SR11 historical records are not mapped by a released executable graph.
Model/design relations exist, but executable_joint_graph=false; current G2 joint closure remains BLOCKED.
MECHANISM_AUDIT records model_dof=2, but V7 audit says DOF/limits are metadata only and current dof_map.json is empty.
Current G2 frames.json is empty; SR11 frame labels are model-defined only and exact executable frame transforms are not released.
R4.1 global convention +X=FWD,+Y=LEFT,+Z=UP is explicit; exact joint/local axes are not uniformly released. J_SEATBACK has conflicting historical/model representations.
The controlled definition master explicitly sets +X=FWD,+Y=LEFT,+Z=UP with right-hand rotation.
Current G2 constraints.json contains an empty constraints array and says equations/reactions/limits/state semantics are not closed.
End-stop and limit concepts exist, but executable numeric limits/reaction definitions are not proven.
Lock/rebound state names are defined; hardware/model state semantics are not executable closure.
No authoritative numerical initial pose/orientation/q/velocity/angular velocity/initial constraint-state set exists.
Declared scope is kinematic/constraint execution only; dynamic force/mass/inertia/contact parameters are excluded at this gate, but remain mandatory for later dynamic extension.
